restriction.android:title: Send read receipts
restriction.android:description: Allow outgoing read receipts. When disabled, read receipts are never sent regardless of the in-app setting.

restriction.android:title: Send typing indicators
restriction.android:description: Allow outgoing typing indicators. When disabled, typing indicators are never sent regardless of the in-app setting.

restriction.android:title: Honor incoming remote deletes
restriction.android:description: When disabled, messages remotely deleted by other users or group admins are kept on this device.

restriction.android:title: Default to high-quality media
restriction.android:description: Send photos and videos at high quality by default.

restriction.android:title: Incognito keyboard by default
restriction.android:description: Request that keyboards disable personalized learning while typing in the app.

restriction.android:title: Screen security by default
restriction.android:description: Block screenshots and hide app contents in the recent-apps preview (FLAG_SECURE) by default.

restriction.android:title: Disable PIN reminders
restriction.android:description: Suppress periodic Signal PIN reminder prompts.

restriction.android:title: Hide store rating prompt
restriction.android:description: Never show the app store rating prompt.

restriction.android:title: Maximum media items per send
restriction.android:description: Maximum number of photos/videos that can be attached to a single message.
